page.content:
Last Byzantine emperor, killed in the 1453 defense.

How Constantine XI Palaiologos connects

  • Event: Fall of Constantinople — Constantine XI died defending the city in 1453.
  • Topic: Byzantine Empire — Constantine XI was the last Byzantine emperor.

What is Constantine XI Palaiologos?

Constantine XI was the last emperor of the Romans. He died in the fighting when Ottoman forces entered Constantinople on 29 May 1453.

Key threads lead to Fall of Constantinople and Byzantine Empire.
